Author: KryptonResearch14
Text: $PFE Pfizer presented Phase 3 vitiligo data for LITFULO yesterday at EADV in Vienna: two trials, 2,174 patients, which Pfizer says is the largest oral systemic program in nonsegmental vitiligo to date. At the 100 mg dose, 21.86% of patients hit F-VASI75 at week 52 vs 2.40% on placebo. Total-body T-VASI50 was 13.02% vs 2.40%. The 50 mg dose came in at roughly half the effect. Benefit showed up by week 24 and kept growing through week 52. One level down: Incyte's Opzelura is the only FDA-approved vitiligo treatment, and it is a topical cream limited to 10% of body surface area. A once-daily oral has no coverage ceiling. But the oral race already has two horses. AbbVie's Rinvoq just won EU approval for vitiligo and is under FDA review. Safety read clean against placebo: serious adverse events 3.4% in both arms of the larger trial. Filings to FDA and EMA are the next catalyst.
